question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be allowed, and what redaction, permission, retention, command-data, and export boundaries must they follow?
rationale: The requested feature is plausible and aligned with dashboard ergonomics, but it creates a new always-visible surface for logs and command output and depends on unresolved dashboard binding/security decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open until the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and the stream/command-output security model are reviewed, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Allow Read-Only Existing Sources First
options.body: Permit a narrow widget PR that only consumes existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, with no new command execution or generic command binding.

options.title: Defer Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets or move the capability into a plugin API discussion.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and the stream/command-output security model are reviewed, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing `logs.tail` surface and related Control UI log work provide the clearest merged-history anchor for the security and product boundary decision.
